gloss_en: the complete utterance (ma'amar ha-shalem) — the full divine saying, exemplified by 'Bereishit' as the first of the ten utterances of creation, associated with the father, supernal Wisdom, prayer, the hidden, and Ein Sof, as opposed to the 'half utterance' (chatzi ma'amar) of any lower level relative to the level above it (Likutey Moharan I:22)
